changes.how: List every value import inside the catalogue folder: rg -n --pcre2 '^import (?!type)' src/lib/admin-messages -g '*.ts' -g '!*.test.ts' (36 lines in 14 files today: screens.en.ts, common.en.ts, animation.en.ts, products.en.ts, notifications.nb.ts, fiken.nb.ts, orders.en.ts and seven more the command prints). Each imports a constant from a code module (for example orders.en.ts takes ARCHIVE_REASON_TEXT from ../order-archive, BULK_ACTION_LABELS, BULK_REASON_TEXT and BULK_REQUEST_TEXT from ../order-bulk, BULK_MAX, VIEWS_MAX and VIEW_TITLE_MAX from ../order-limits). Two cases. (a) The imported constant is TEXT (a label table such as ARCHIVE_REASON_TEXT, BOOKING_WORDS, STATUS_WORDS, ANIMATION_WORDS): turn the edge around. Move the constant's literal into the catalogue file (or, when server code, the AI manager or a test reads the same English, into a small label module beside those readers, named <thing>-labels.ts, that imports nothing but types) and make the old home import it from the label module, not from the catalogue. (b) The imported constant is a NUMBER or a list of ids used inside a sentence (BULK_MAX, VIEWS_MAX, STOREFRONT_ROUTES, ANALYTICS_TABLES): move it to a module that has no other imports (for example src/lib/order-limits.ts already is one: check with rg -n '^import' on it; if it imports nothing but types it may stay as the one allowed kind) or write the sentence with a {placeholder} that the reader fills, as other entries of the same file do. Do one catalogue file per commit, English and Norwegian of the same area together. Start with orders.en.ts.

do_not: Do not change any sentence's wording, in English or Norwegian: move constants, do not edit them. src/lib/brand.scan.test.ts and the message-key scan must stay green without edits.
Do not delete a catalogue key because its importer changed.
Do not make a client component import an area module or a catalogue to get its words; words come down as props (step 2.26).
Do not keep a `?? xEn` fallback 'for safety', and do not replace it by an empty string or a cast: the argument becomes required and the type checker finds the callers.
Do not use `export *` from a catalogue in an area module in a way that re-exports another area.
Do not touch src/lib/messages/{lang}.ts (the storefront's own text): this step is the admin's catalogues only.
Do not add an entry to any scan's exception list.
stop_if: The area modules of step 2.25 do not exist (src/lib/admin-text.ts still holds a table of every area), or either scan test of step 1.4 is missing.

A function that took a default is called from a place with no language and no words at all (a database trigger's text, a cron job's email with no store language): do not guess a language; list the call and stop.
A constant is needed by a catalogue sentence and by code, and moving it would create an import circle.
A test must change more than its import path or one added argument to pass.
After all three groups the median admin page is still over 18 areas or /admin/[store]/orders over 6.5 MB: report the top areas the scan prints for the worst entries.
